translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Ngʼat ma ok jahera dwaro mana gige
ok owinj puonj moro amora.
Ngʼat mofuwo ok mor kod winjo wach
to omor mana gi wacho paroge owuon.
Ka richo biro, e kaka achaya biro,
to wichkuot kelo duwruok.
Weche mag dho ngʼato tut ka nam,
to soko mar rieko en aora mabubni kamol.
Ok en gima ber chwako ngʼat ma timbene richo
kata ketho buch ngʼato maonge ketho.
Lew ngʼat mofuwo kelone dhawo,
to dhoge luongo goch.
Dho ngʼat mofuwo ema tieke,
to lewe ema bedo obadho ne ngimane.
Weche mag kuoth chalo gi chiemo mamit;
gidhiyo e chuny dhano ma iye.
Ngʼat ma jasamuoyo e tich
en owadgi ngʼat maketho gik moko.
Nying Jehova Nyasaye en ohinga maratego,
ngʼat makare ringo ma pond kanyo kendo yud resruok.
Mwandu mar jomoko e ohinga mochiel motegno ma gigengʼorego,
giparo ni en ohinga maonge ngʼama nyalo muko.
Kapok ngʼato opodho, to sunga bedo e chunye,
to muolo kelo pak.
Chik iti kapok idwoko wach;
ka ok itimo kamano to ibedo mofuwo kendo ikelo wichkuot.
Chuny ngʼato sire e tuo,
to chuny mool, en ngʼa manyalo konyo?
Chuny ma weche donjone yudo ngʼeyo;
to it mariek dwaro mondo weche odonjne.
Chiwo yawo yo ne ngʼat machiwo
kendo tere e nyim jomadongo.
Ngʼat mokwongo keto wachne nenore ni en kare,
nyaka ngʼat machielo bi maket penjo ne wachneno.
Goyo ombulu tieko larruok
kendo thego joma roteke.
Kiketho ne owadu to duoge iri tek
mana kadonjo e dala maduongʼ mochiel motegno;
to larruok chalo gi dhorangeye mag dala modin gi lodi.
Wach mawuok e dho ngʼato ema miyo ngʼato yiengʼ;
keyo mar dhoge ema miyo oyiengʼ.
Lep nigi teko mar ngima kod tho,
to jogo mohere biro chamo olembe.
Ngʼatno moyudo dhako onwangʼo gima ber
kendo oyudo ngʼwono moa kuom Jehova Nyasaye.
Ngʼat ma jachan ywak kokwayo ngʼwono,
to ngʼat ma jamoko dwoko gi gero.
Ngʼat man-gi osiepe mangʼeny nyalo chopo e kethruok
to nitie osiep moro masiko buti machiegni maloyo owadu.
